newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian bourse index slips slightly.
newsitem.headline: Estonian bourse index slips slightly.

text.p: The index slipped slightly on the Estonian bourse on Tuesday while volume rose, the Tallinn Stock Exchange said in a statement.
Overall market volume reached almost 8.2 million kroons compares with six million kroons on Monday and the index slipped 0.1 percent to 97.80.

Market leader Hansa Bank dominated activity for the second straight day with over 3.9 million kroons worth of its shares trading hands and it closed at 94.00 kroons compared with 93.80 kroons on Monday.
Hansa Bank, the largest bank in the Baltic states, has steadily risen since the release last month of favourable results for the first half of 1996.
Forex Bank's shares were also active at almost 1.9 million kroons but its share price closed down at 77.60 kroons compared with 78.20 kroons on Monday.
Savings Bank shares also dropped, closing at 37.20 kroons compared with 37.65 kroons on Monday.
Savings Bank, the second largest in the Baltic state, was given the green light by the central bank to merge with the Bank of Industry on Monday.
